items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: Yeah, you told me that, Mark.

ctx.x: That is the closest thing to the old type of music that Bud... That Oliver played in those days. Yes, yes. They were dressed up and they were big shots and all that. And the attitude was very nice. I mean, the one that was pretty much of a... felt his oats very much was Baby Todd's when he was in Chicago. But Oliver was just as cordial and nice as he could be.
